prompt: Create exactly one 9:16 vertical style reference sheet — a texture and palette sample, not a scene. Medium: layered paper cut. Texture family: matte archival cardstock with clean knife-cut bevels, subtle paper grain tooth, and physical sheet layering. Palette: cool cyan and pale sky-blue atmosphere, warm cream and bone-white structural elements, muted lavender and slate stone bases, warm straw yellow, and restrained coral-orange accents reserved for load stress, structural compression, and fracture points. Line treatment: crisp silhouette cut edges and pressed sculptural creases with zero drawn ink outlines. Lighting: soft directional studio illumination casting tangible cast shadows between layered paper depths to articulate physical mass and cross-sectional scale. Avoid: No enclosing frames, shadowbox borders, card margins, inset windows, or page edges; no visible glue, wires, or digital vector flatting; no embedded text, typographic callouts, labels, or anatomical gore. No characters, no text, no logos, no photorealism. The attached operator_style_reference is style-only: use its palette, material texture, line language and lighting as inspiration for this original neutral anchor. Do not copy its subject, composition, text, logo, person, or recognizable layout.
